paragraphs.text: The River Toloron is a river in south-western Jamuraa on Dominaria .

The Toloron divides the Western Wastes from the Sukurvian Desert . Sourced in the Blue Mountains , it streams south some two hundred leagues, or six hundred miles, past the city-states of Tirras , Palmyra and Bryce , into the Bay of Pearls and the Sea of Serenity . The river connects into the Sunken Sea beneath Sukurvia . It is a lazy river, flowing mildly across smooth bends, allowing for riverboats to comfortably travel all the way from the sea to past Tirras. At Bryce, the river split in many smaller branches, forming a delta upon which the city was perched, connected through many bridges.
